synopsis: ISO 18571 combines corridor, phase, magnitude and slope sub-scores into a single number often called the “ISO score” [f15332]. Euro NCAP’s on-road virtual-testing protocol requires manufacturers to qualify simulation in-house against physical tests using the ISO score and defined KPIs calculated with Euro NCAP scripts [f15333, f2496]. This qualification sits within a broader submission process covering model dossiers and color-coded predictions for the whole scenario grid [f15447]. Several ISO-score and KPI tolerances remain bracketed and require confirmation, so they should not be adopted as final thresholds in an off-road acceptance specification [f2502, f2503].

relations.note: Both require simulation qualification against physical tests using the ISO score and defined KPIs.
